table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,  
		saleperson=(select  name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=saleledger.smancode), 
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
         accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
		reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
		serverdate=getdate(),  
		custalias=accounts.aliasname,
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2, 
		 custntnno=customer.ntnno,  
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
         date = dbo.saleledger.date,
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
			salecatcode = dbo.saleledger.salecatcode,
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = saledetail.batch,   
         expiry = saledetail.expiry,  
		manfdate=(select min(manfdate) from purdetail where purdetail.icode=item.icode), 
         looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
         bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
         packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
         packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
         salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
         Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=saleledger.posted,   
         balance=ISNULL(saleledger.balance, 0), 
		amt=saleledger.amt,  
		saleledger.printbalance,
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
custrefno2=	dbo.saleledger.custrefno2,	
			dbo.saleledger.remarks,
			dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
			dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			
			messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode)

    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

ORDER BY /*dbo.item.customicode,*/
			dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode,
			dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)
